inspector.noDocument: Open a scene to inspect what is in it.
inspector.noSelection: Select an object to see its properties.
inspector.alignCamera: Put this camera where the view is looking
inspector.alignCameraHint: Gives the camera the place and the direction of the current view
inspector.addRail: Create a path for this camera
inspector.addRailHint: Lays a path in front of the camera, down its line of sight, and binds it to this shot
inspector.addPathPoint: Add a point to the path
inspector.addPathPointHint: Sets one more point at the end of the path, halfway from the last one
inspector.name: Name
inspector.resetHint: Puts this property back where it stood before anything changed it
inspector.stackFoldHint: Put the axes back on one line
inspector.stackUnfoldHint: Unfold the axes, one per line
inspector.linkAxesHint: Moving one axis takes the others with it, in the ratio they held when it was locked
inspector.holdAxisHint: A held axis moves for nothing — not typing, not dragging, not the viewport handle
inspector.axisHeldHint: This axis is held — let it go to change it
inspector.rotationInert: A sprite always faces the camera: turning it shows only if it carries children
inspector.pickPictureHint: Opens the project’s image picker. A double-click opens this one where it is edited
inspector.clearTextureHint: Clears this slot — the image stays in the project
inspector.browseTextureHint: Choose from the images this project holds, as thumbnails rather than a list
inspector.openTextureHint: Double-click to open this image in the space that edits it
inspector.empty: Select something to see its properties.
inspector.roleGuessed: Guessed from the extension. To correct it, this file has to be an asset of the project
inspector.pinHint: Keep it on the home screen, in every project
inspector.pinFull: The home screen holds {{max}} recipes at most — unpin one to pin this one
inspector.regenerateHint: Open the generator with these parameters
inspector.clearSkyHint: Hands the view back to the studio sky — the image stays in the project
inspector.openSkyHint: Double-click to open this sky in its own space
inspector.chooseFontHint: Opens the list of fonts this machine can read
inspector.noFontOffered: No font this machine can read
inspector.clearScriptHint: The component stays, with no code to run
inspector.openScriptHint: Shows the file in the code editor
inspector.title: Title
inspector.expressionHint: Write CEL: a wire reads as the id of the node it comes from, then _output
inspector.foldAllHint: Folds every group at once, to get back to the top of the panel
inspector.unfoldAllHint: Opens every group again at once
inspector.rigNotHumanoid: The studio only lays a humanoid skeleton — hips, spine, two arms and two legs.
inspector.rigRegenerateConfirm: Regenerating replaces the whole skeleton: IK chains, hand-added bones and renamings will be lost. Continue?
inspector.autoRigUseSurfaceNormalsHint: Improves weight separation when limbs are close or touching. Slower and more memory intensive.
inspector.autoRigMiaSettingsHint: These settings are applied to the next run. Simplified mode suits joined fingers; detailed mode keeps all five chains when they are clearly separated.

autoRigErrors.MODEL_NOT_INSTALLED: Advanced Auto Rig requires its local model.
autoRigErrors.MODEL_INVALID: The Advanced Auto Rig model is incomplete or corrupted.
autoRigErrors.ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE: The local Auto Rig engine is unavailable.
autoRigErrors.UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM: Advanced Auto Rig is not supported on this machine.
autoRigErrors.INVALID_MESH: This model does not contain usable triangle geometry.
autoRigErrors.NOT_HUMANOID: Advanced Auto Rig could not identify a humanoid character.
autoRigErrors.INFERENCE_FAILED: Advanced Auto Rig could not finish.
autoRigErrors.OUT_OF_MEMORY: There is not enough available memory for Advanced Auto Rig.

inspector.rigReady: This model has been given a skeleton.
inspector.animationLibraryEmpty: No animation in this project yet.
inspector.animationImportHint: Accepted formats: {{formats}}. Files are copied into the project’s Animations folder.
inspector.animationAiNone: No motion service in the catalogue.
inspector.animationFits: The character can play this motion.
inspector.animationFitsPartly: The animation is not a perfect fit.
inspector.rigServicesLocked: Remote services can do this too; the {{plan}} subscription does not allow them. The studio does it itself, for free.
inspector.rigServicesTooLarge: This model is over the {{limit}} limit of the remote services. The studio has no such limit.
inspector.rigFault_noGeometry: This model is too flat to take a skeleton.
inspector.rigFault_lyingDown: This model is lying down. Stand it up before making it animatable.
inspector.rigStatus_staticMesh: This model cannot be animated yet.
inspector.rigStatus_skinnedMesh: This model has a skeleton with no recognised joints.
inspector.rigStatus_riggedCharacter: This character is ready to animate.
inspector.rigStatus_skeletonOnly: This file holds a skeleton only, with no character to animate.
inspector.revealHint: Opens the file manager on the selected asset
inspector.addBranch: Add a branch, with its output
inspector.removeBranch: Remove this branch and its output
inspector.addCondition: Add a condition to this branch
inspector.combine: How this combines with the condition above
inspector.noFontHint: No font picked; the text keeps the document’s own
inspector.lock_pixelsHint: Stops paint from landing on this layer, without pinning it in place
inspector.lock_positionHint: Stops the layer from being moved; it can still be painted on
inspector.lock_alphaHint: Paints only where the layer already has something
inspector.addList: Add a list to iterate over, with the port giving its item
inspector.removeList: Remove this list and the port giving its item
inspector.modelExtractTextureHint: Extracts embedded maps into Materials and replaces the file map with the base colour when present
inspector.modelDressExtraSlots: This model has only {{slots, number}} materials: the last {{count, number}} slots dress nothing.
inspector.modelDressExtraSlots_one: This model has only {{slots, number}} materials: the last slot dresses nothing.
inspector.modelDressAddSlotHint: One more empty slot — a model wears one material per material of its mesh
inspector.modelDressRemoveSlotHint: Removes the last slot — the material stays in the project
inspector.modelDressAssembleHint: Builds a material from the images the model’s file carries, opens it, and puts it on this slot
inspector.modelDressOpenMaterialHint: Opens it in the Materials space — the model follows whatever is edited there
inspector.modelDressClearMaterialHint: This slot goes back to the file’s own material — the document stays in the project
inspector.pixelArtPreviewTooWide: Too many cells to show one pixel each
